svg.title: In Iceberg v1 to v3, table metadata points to a manifest list that is rewritten on every commit and has one entry per manifest, so a small append writes a new manifest and a growing list. In v4, table metadata points to a Parquet root manifest that holds leaf manifests and can hold data files directly; small appends go straight into the root, and a deletion bitmap on the root's entry marks files in a leaf as removed without rewriting the leaf.
svg.text: the list is rewritten on every commit,
one entry per manifest, so it grows
with the table, not the change
leaves stay untouched; a bit on the root
entry marks a file in them as removed

figure.figcaption: The manifest list grows with the table. The root manifest grows with the change, as long as someone keeps it small.
